# iximiuz-labs_playground (Data Source)

Looks up a single iximiuz Labs playground by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iximiuz-labs_playground" "docker" {
  name = "docker"
}

output "playground_title" {
  value = data.iximiuz-labs_playground.docker.title
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name of the playground.

### Read-Only

- `base` (String) The base playground this playground extends.
- `cover` (String) The cover image URL of the playground.
- `description` (String) A short description of the playground.
- `id` (String) Server-generated playground ID.
- `owner` (String) The owner of the playground.
- `page_url` (String) Web UI URL for the playground.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the playground is published.
- `title` (String) The display title of the playground.
